descriptive_join_qc_layer.duplication_policy: Aggregate GBIF rows to country-month before any descriptive join; do not duplicate surveillance rows by raw host records.
descriptive_join_qc_layer.missingness_policy: Retain all ECDC country-month rows. GBIF non-matches remain explicit non-coverage. Preserve suppressed/non-numeric ECDC counts as missing numeric values.
descriptive_join_qc_layer.spatial_alignment_rule: Restrict to two-letter country codes present in both sources without attempting subnational harmonization.
descriptive_join_qc_layer.temporal_alignment_rule: Restrict to YYYY-MM monthly alignment only; do not aggregate annual surveillance or infer zero counts from missing host rows.

guardrails: this gate defines prerequisites only and does not ingest real analysis data
this gate does not authorize risk, abundance, human-case, Rt, spillover, host-switch, or surveillance-join outputs
all real source data must pass provenance and terms review before analysis
remaining_requirements: explicit approval remains required for any inferential or modeling use beyond descriptive join QC
country-code harmonization review for non-overlap codes such as EL and UK
title: Cross-source join and bias review gate
